notesStmt.note: This manuscript fragment contributed to "Notes (such as they are) founded on Elias Hicks," which Whitman wrote during the months leading up to the publication of November Boughs in the fall of 1888.

note.p: This manuscript is a partial draft of "George Fox (and Shakspere)," the final section of "Notes (such as they are) founded on Elias Hicks," an essay first published in November Boughs (1888) and later reprinted in Complete Prose Works (1892).
